rows.independent_primary_read_extent: Primary printed pp79,86,103–104 read; second-edition imprint independently checked.
rows.assessment: The labor/work and necessity/freedom criticisms are present. The1958 argument is not dated1998; Margaret Canovan’s1998 introduction is separately credited. Arendt’s opening disavowal of indiscriminate anti-Marxism is retained.

rows.independent_primary_read_extent: Primary printed pp119–120 and124–126 read;1990/1999/2002 imprint independently checked.
rows.assessment: The immanent criticism of the Barbin introduction and romanticization is explicit. The locators belong to the1999 edition, not a collated1990 copy; productive use of Foucault remains part of the argument.

rows.independent_primary_read_extent: Primary printed xviii–xx visually checked in the scan.
rows.assessment: Ginzburg’s criticism targets exclusion over excluded subjects and refusal of interpretation. John and Anne Tedeschi share the English translation credit. Existing259/268 concern later evidentiary/textual debates rather than this named preface response.

rows.independent_primary_read_extent: Reformatted primary digital pp12–13 read, with title/English translation imprint checked.
rows.assessment: The corrective is explicit, and p13 refuses leveling historical differences between democracy and totalitarianism. Digital page numbers are not Stanford print locators. Existing1568 is the opposite-direction methodological-resource claim, so this is not a duplicate directed critique.

existing_pair_records.claim: Agamben explicitly invokes Foucault’s panopticon and archaeology as resources for his paradigmatic method.

rows.independent_primary_read_extent: Primary letter heading/date and printed pp120–123 visually read from the rotated scanned spreads.
rows.assessment: The letter identifies18March1936 and argues that both autonomous and reproduced art have contradictory capacities. The English collection is later; no sole translator is inferred and no following1938 letter is treated as the same document.

rows.independent_primary_read_extent: Primary reformatted digital pp4–5 body discussion of Anderson independently read; Profession91 citation checked in the header.
rows.assessment: Pratt analytically appropriates imagined communities in her speech-community/contact-zone discussion. This is not a claim that Anderson thought actual nations homogeneous and not a Pratt-to-Anderson attack.
